features.description: D — bounded retry with jittered backoff on Gemini _ResourceExhaustedError, an honest Danish message on exhaustion, and a written-down quota ceiling for the rest of the pilot
acceptance_criteria: A simulated 429 burst results in a completed turn rather than a terminated stream
Retry exhaustion produces a user-visible Danish message, not a stalled stream
The actual prod Gemini/Vertex quota and the ceiling needed for the remaining pilot are recorded as numbers in the design doc
features.notes: Done, larger than planned. Two findings changed the design: (1) Vertex Gemini 2.x here runs under Dynamic Shared Quota — there is NO per-project QPM to raise, so the ceiling question has no engineering answer, only Provisioned Throughput (a purchasing decision for M). (2) ADK wraps its whole streaming loop in one try, so a 429 can arrive mid-stream; a blind retry would duplicate visible text. Retry therefore fires ONLY before the first token. Also found _ResourceExhaustedError IS a ClientError, so it was already caught — but fell to the generic branch and showed students 'Upstream API error (429): {raw}'. Added a typed QUOTA_EXHAUSTED code with Danish text. 17 new tests.
